messages:
Alex P.: I'm taking primary for the 0600-1400 UTC window. leaving notes here for whoever's swapping in later. main points: cross-region traffic is higher than usual, watch the kv-cache hit rate, and we've got a slightly noisy healthcheck from serve-runtime in eu-west. I'll stay on pager for the first 30m.
Maria T.: thanks. i'm secondary until 1000 UTC then Samir takes over. any open pagers?
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: INC-4231 — 503 spikes on /v1/generate (region: eu-west)
Alex P.: copy. INC-4231 is currently paging — spike started ~1729456000. impact: intermittent 503s, p95 latency up ~2x for eu-west customers. low error rate globally.
Samir G.: is this the one tied to kv-cache evictions we saw last week?
Maria T.: looks similar; memory pressure on the inference nodes caused cache thrash earlier. check the KV cache hit-rate dashboard: https://redwood-internal/obs/dashboards/kv-cache-eu-west
Alex P.: quick checklist for anyone answering the pager: 1) check serve-runtime pod logs 2) check node memory + OOM events 3) verify redis/kv-service connectivity 4) fallback routing to model-variant-small if latency persists.
Samir G.: i'm on logs. tailing serve-runtime: ```kubectl -n inference logs -l app=serve-runtime -c runtime -f | sed -n '1,200p'``` seeing repeated `kv cache miss -> fetch backend` and some 504 upstreams to kv-service.
Maria T.: can someone run a quick health probe: ```curl -sS -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null https://eu-west.api.redwood/v1/health```
Alex P.: ran it, got 200 0.12s but a few 503s in the last minute. checking node memory: `kubectl top pod -n inference` shows two pods at 92% mem.
ops-rotator: added runbook links to channel: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oncall/kv-cache-fallback and https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oncall/scale-serve-runtime. also attaching quick commands snippet.
Alex P.: quick mitigation plan: A) scale inference pool in eu-west by +2 replicas (if autoscaler not catching). B) temporarily lower concurrency for the runtime route to reduce memory pressure. C) if persists, flip traffic to fallback model variant (smaller quantized) for eu-west via routing policy.
Maria T.: i'll scale first while Samir reduces concurrency. Samir, can you patch the route config? small snippet: ```kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: redwood/v1
kind: RouteConfig
metadata:
  name: gen-euw
spec:
  concurrencyLimit: 8
EOF
```
Samir G.: applying now. also bumping replica count: ```kubectl -n inference scale deploy/serve-runtime --replicas=6```
Alex P.: giving the cluster 2-3 minutes to stabilize. reminder: if we hit more than 5% error rate for >5m, do the routing flip and notify customers. log the decision in INC-4231 ticket when flipped.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-4231 updated: mitigation step applied (scale + concurrency throttle).
Maria T.: after scale, mem usage dropped to ~70% across pods, KV hits back to normal. p95 dropped to ~1.1x baseline. looks good so far.
Samir G.: confirming no OOM logs and redis latency normalized. leaving a quick remediation snippet for future responders: 
- check dashboards: https://redwood-internal/obs/dashboards/kv-cache-eu-west
- scale command: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/serve-runtime --replicas=<n>`
- concurrency patch: apply RouteConfig snippet (reduce by 30%)
- fallback flip: `POST https://console-api.redwood/internal/routing/flip` body `{ "route": "gen-euw", "variant": "small-quant" }` (ensure ops key)
Alex P.: good notes. i'm documenting handoff in PagerDuty: primary->Maria at 1000 UTC, Maria->Samir at 1400 UTC. leaving these runbook links in the incident: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oncall/kv-cache-fallback , https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oncall/serve-runtime-restart, and the playbook for customer comms: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oncall/customer-notify-template.
Maria T.: small follow-up: if we flip to fallback, toggle the eval watchdog to avoid quality regressions: `PATCH /v1/eval/watchdog` set `monitor:false` during flip and re-enable after canary 5m.
Samir G.: noted. if anything else pops up i can take a quick bridge. otherwise marking this as monitored and stable — will add post-incident notes to INC-4231.
Alex P.: thanks all — i'll drop final handoff note when I sign off. :white_check_mark:
Maria T.: copying handoff checklist into the shift doc: https://redwood-internal/shift-notes/2026-03-14-eu-west-shift (ops-only).
Alex P.: handing off: primary -> Maria T. at 1000 UTC. contact list in the doc. last check: all good, closing active pager watch but leaving incident open for 1h monitoring.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-4231 status: monitoring -> acknowledged
Samir G.: thanks — leaving a short postmortem pointer in the ticket: track root cause to be investigated by infra team (possible garbage-collection or cache sizing mismatch).
Alex P.: end of thread — quick playbook summary included in the runbook link above. any gaps call me on pager.
_meta: generated for dataset: on-call handoff + runbook pointers thread
